clue.text: Lawman's obligation to keep record

indicators.note: to keep means the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: a duty is an obligation
EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A sheriff talks about his duty to keep the files in order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to keep' puts EP inside DUTY; the 's of Lawman's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A deputy is an assistant sheriff in American westerns, a classic lawman.

clue.text: Sport help given to cover child-rearing by one out of touch

indicators.note: rearing up, in a down clue, means the whole assembly is read from the bottom up

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a sport

indicators.note: the help is given the job of covering, so it holds the child inside

parts.note: aid is help
a son is a child

explanation.surface: Sports help is offered to a parent bringing up a child, by someone hopelessly old-fashioned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'child-rearing' looks like one idea but splits: 'child' is fodder and 'rearing' turns the whole build (ASONID after RU) upwards; 'given to cover' is the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone a dinosaur is an idiom for a person stuck in the past and out of touch.

clue.text: Plan for time cut out of delivery service

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: cut out of means a letter is removed from the following word

parts.note: postal describes the mail delivery service

explanation.surface: A scheme to axe hours from the mail service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut out of' removes the time letter, leaving POSAL; the surface makes 'delivery service' sound like a business plan.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposal is a suggested scheme put forward, so a plan.

clue.text: Article at length details robbery

parts.note: the is the definite article
FT, feet, is a unit of length

explanation.surface: A long newspaper piece goes into the particulars of a robbery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at' and 'details' are link words joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Theft and robbery are both words for stealing, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Worldly worker briefly employed test

parts.note: a temp is a temporary worker
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A worldly-wise temporary employee takes an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Temporal means secular, of this world, as opposed to spiritual.

clue.text: 17, for example, get in with chaps splitting spoil

parts.note: to enter is to get in

indicators.note: splitting means the chaps break the spoil word apart by sitting inside it

parts.note: to taint is to spoil
men are chaps

explanation.surface: A song and dance where you gatecrash and a gang of blokes ruins it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'splitting' is the container signal. 17 across is SONG AND DANCE, a kind of show business.
explanation.definitionFit: A song and dance is a kind of show, which is an example of entertainment.

clue.text: Won when people start to give up about one

indicators.note: start means the first letter of the word people
about means the turned word goes round the letter for one
up, in a down clue, means the word for give is read upwards

parts.note: to deliver is to give, hand over
A means one

explanation.surface: Victory came when the crowd began to surrender a single point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns DELIVER into REVILED, and 'about' puts A inside it, making REVAILED; 'start' gives the P of people in front. The surface suggests giving up, but 'give' and 'up' do separate jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: To have prevailed is to have triumphed, which is to have won.

clue.text: Cycling club?

parts.note: the club meant is not for bicycles but a service organisation whose name means turning round in circles, with its wheel emblem

explanation.definitionFit: Rotary International is a club, and rotary means revolving, hence cycling.

clue.text: Thing for turning right in flap

parts.note: a lathe is a machine for turning wood or metal

explanation.surface: Someone turning to the right gets in a panic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link word; to be in a flap is to be in a lather.
explanation.definitionFit: A lather and a flap are both informal words for a state of nervous agitation.

clue.text: Running loop quickly swung point

indicators.note: swung means the word for quickly is swung round, read backwards

parts.note: soon means quickly, before long
E is a compass point, east

explanation.surface: A lasso swung swiftly to a sharp point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swung' gives NOOS; 'Running loop' is a slip-knotted loop, not a jogging route.
explanation.definitionFit: A noose is a loop with a running knot that tightens when pulled.

clue.text: Foreign race has in form team short of one child

parts.note: a player in form is said to be hot
a football or cricket team has eleven players, one fewer is ten
a tot is a small child

explanation.surface: An overseas athletics race features an in-form team missing one youngster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is a link word. The answer is an old, now offensive name for the Khoikhoi people of southern Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Hottentot was a dated European term for a people of southern Africa, here called a race.

clue.text: Is it worn after smoking one?

definitions.text: Is it worn after smoking one?

parts.words: Is it worn after smoking one?
parts.note: plays on a coughing fit after a cigarette and on the jacket you might change into after a smoking jacket, the sporty riding coat

explanation.definitionFit: A hacking jacket is a tweed riding jacket, and hacking also means coughing after smoking.

clue.text: Vehicle's wear mark

parts.note: to sport something is to wear it
a scar is a mark

explanation.surface: A car shows wear and a scratch.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of Vehicle's stands for 'is', a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A sports car is a fast two-seater motor vehicle, so a kind of vehicle.

clue.text: Come to terms to do with time-out

indicators.note: out here means the word for time lies outside the other piece

parts.note: an age is a period of time
re means concerning, to do with

explanation.surface: In a time-out, the parties reach a settlement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'time-out' splits into time and the container signal 'out'; the surface reads it as a pause in play.
explanation.definitionFit: To agree is to reach accord, which is to come to terms.

clue.text: Bite at annual festivity is not to be had

indicators.note: festivity suggests the letters are in high spirits, jumbled up

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A snack at the yearly party is impossible to get.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link word; the twelve letters of BITE AT ANNUAL are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unattainable cannot be reached or obtained, so it is not to be had.

clue.text: Crewless vessel according to Matthew?

parts.note: a ship with two masts, said to have no crew because the Gospel of Matthew says no man can serve ...

explanation.definitionFit: A two-master is a sailing ship with two masts; Matthew 6:24 says no man can serve two of them.

clue.text: Ingrained fault rings incomplete

parts.note: a flaw that is literally in the grain of timber, where a branch fell out and the growth rings are broken round a gap

explanation.definitionFit: A knothole is a hole in wood left by a fallen-out knot, a defect in the grain.

clue.text: Mirrored, say, in poor line of woman's gown

indicators.note: poor suggests the letters are in a bad way, so rearranged

parts.note: EG, for example, means say

indicators.note: mirrored means the abbreviation is also written as its reflection, backwards

parts.note: the same EG, seen in the mirror
taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman in a reflected image wears a badly cut gown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' gives EG, and 'Mirrored' adds its reflection GE; with LINE these letters are shuffled by 'poor'. 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A negligee is a woman's light, flimsy dressing gown.

clue.text: Fuss found in Oklahoma?

definitions.meaning: the musical Oklahoma! is full of songs and dances

explanation.definitionFit: Making a song and dance is an idiom for a fuss; musicals consist of singing and dancing.

clue.text: Musical I composed with incidental material

indicators.note: the answer comes along with the clue words incidentally, tucked inside them

explanation.surface: A musical score written alongside background music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with incidental' signals letters lying within 'Musical I composed'.
explanation.definitionFit: Calico is a plain cotton cloth, a kind of material.

clue.text: Join firm in this position

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
here means in this place

explanation.surface: Join the company in this role.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohere is to stick together, so to join.

clue.text: Peculiar flavour of a capital city in its own words

parts.words: capital city in its own words
parts.note: Roma is the Italian name for Rome

explanation.surface: A distinctive taste of the capital, in local parlance.
explanation.definitionFit: An aroma is a distinctive smell, a characteristic flavour.

clue.text: Article located corrupt storytelling

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: corrupt means the following word is spoiled, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece found corrupt tales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corrupt' gives ECDOTAL; 'located' looks like a link meaning found, but it is the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Anecdotal means consisting of anecdotes, short stories, hence storytelling.

clue.text: Pintails prosper

indicators.note: tails means the word is cut at its tail, losing the last letter

parts.note: to do well is to prosper

explanation.surface: Ducks thrive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pintails' (a duck) splits as 'Pin', the definition, and 'tails', which docks the final L of DO WELL.
explanation.definitionFit: A dowel is a wooden pin used to join two pieces.

clue.text: Wanted picture producer?

parts.note: not a film producer but a kit for making the face on a police wanted poster

explanation.definitionFit: An Identikit is a set of facial features used to build a picture of a suspect.

clue.text: Outgrown sin

indicators.note: out means the following letters are out of place, rearranged

explanation.surface: A habit one has outgrown is a sin.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrong is a misdeed, which is the same as a sin.

clue.text: Test requirement that's set too high?

definitions.meaning: in Test cricket the ... is the required number of overs bowled per hour

explanation.definitionFit: Over rate is a cricket term; to overrate is to rate too high.

clue.text: Bring forward porter to take stage

indicators.note: to take means the beer holds the stage inside it

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, an ale
a leg is a stage of a journey

explanation.surface: A porter is brought forward to take the next stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take' is the container signal. Porter is a dark beer, not a luggage carrier.
explanation.definitionFit: To allege is to put forward a claim, bring it forward.
